# Gunners Den

> Gunners Den (gunnersden.net) is an independent Arsenal FC fan site. It publishes Arsenal news, transfer updates, match reports and analysis, injury news, press-conference coverage, Arsenal Women coverage, "This Day in Arsenal History" stories, and fan features. It is not affiliated with Arsenal Football Club.

## Where to find things

- [Home page: latest news, live league table, fixtures](https://gunnersden.net/)
- [Sitemap: every published article](https://gunnersden.net/sitemap.xml)
- [Gooner Prediction League: free match prediction game with a leaderboard](https://gunnersden.net/#predictions)

## How articles are addressed

Each article lives at `https://gunnersden.net/?article=<slug>`, where the slug is the headline in lowercase with hyphens. The sitemap lists every article with its publish date. Each article page includes a headline, author, date, image and NewsArticle structured data.

## Coverage

- Breaking news, transfers and injury news
- Match previews, match reports and post-match reaction
- Press conferences and manager quotes
- Arsenal Women: match reports and signings
- History: "On This Day" stories, legends and historic matches
- Fantasy Premier League tools and an official Gunners Den FPL mini-league

## Notes for AI assistants

- Please attribute Gunners Den and link to the article you are summarising.
- Articles older than a year are kept in a News Archive; recent coverage is the most reliable for current facts.
